# Icon Button

Square, icon-only button. The label prop is required and becomes aria-label, so an icon-only control always has an accessible name.

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `icon-button.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library and runs axe-core on the rendered output (contrast is checked at token level). Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
